title: Warm Shaggy Syrian Lamb Kebabs
description: Savory Syrian lamb kebabs served with iceberg lettuce and a rich deglaze fond, perfect for a low-calorie date night dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Thread the lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb with olive oil and season with garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Place the skewers in a terracotta dish and bake for 20 minutes.
Remove the skewers from the oven and place them on a plate.
Add the red wine and chicken broth to the terracotta dish, scraping up any browned bits from the bottom.
Bring the wine and broth mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes.
Serve the lamb kebabs on top of the iceberg lettuce leaves, spooning some of the deglaze fond over the top of each kebab.
